The grey‑market premium for Acevector is currently quoted at roughly 6.2 percent of the upper price band of ₹32, implying a premium of about ₹2 and an estimated listing price near ₹34. This level suggests that the unofficial market is pricing in a modest listing gain, but the indicator itself is unregulated, thinly traded and highly volatile; premiums of this magnitude can evaporate entirely before the shares begin trading on the exchange, so it should be treated only as a rough sentiment gauge rather than a reliable predictor.

Subscription data for the issue is not yet visible. The bidding window opened on 25 September and runs through 29 September, and no breakdown of qualified institutional, non‑institutional or retail demand has been disclosed at this stage. Until the book‑building numbers are released, it is not possible to assess whether institutional conviction, leveraged high‑net‑worth participation or retail interest is driving the order flow.
